O0.reason: frame: stack frame layout differs in neatroff-reg
ref: wrong reference sec in neatroff-reg

notes: O0: num_set fails on frame (16 vs 8 bytes): gcc sizes the frame differently when nreg has no body in the TU, and that body belongs to another function. num_setfmt and tr_ta match in code but fail the .rodata ref check (O0 literals sit in plain .rodata, which objcmp compares by offset, so the TU's other literals decide it); tr_ta also differs in index evaluation order and a spilled r12. O1: num_set, num_setfmt and str_rm pass; tr_ta differs in register use and the folded prev-tab index. O2: num_set cannot match because gcc inlines nreg into the target, which needs nreg's body; tr_ta's loop is peeled differently. Harness: static variables that no function in this partial TU writes or reads were folded or dropped at O1/O2, so env and sregs_dat carry __attribute__((used)); this is a source deviation, disclosed here. Partial-TU effects dominate the O1/O2 numbers for this suite.
